note: Verdict degisiklikleri. Yeni girisi basa ekle. date: YYYY-MM-DD, from/to: verdict anahtari; from=null ise yeni entry.

entries.title: Accountant
entries.why: First published. The data entry is already gone. The signature and the trust are not.

entries.title: Copywriter
entries.why: First published. Nobody is buying words any more. They are buying the judgment about which words.

entries.title: Customer Support Agent
entries.why: First published. Tier 1 is already a bot. What is left is every conversation the bot made worse.

entries.title: Data Analyst
entries.why: First published. Anyone can get the number now. Knowing which number to ask for is the job.

entries.title: Graphic Designer
entries.why: First published. Generation is free now. Choosing, and defending the choice, is the whole job.

entries.title: Lawyer
entries.why: First published. Research and drafting hours are evaporating. The bar card and the blame are not transferable.

entries.title: Marketer
entries.why: First published. Execution went to zero, so everyone is executing. Deciding what not to do is the remaining edge.

entries.title: Nurse
entries.why: First published. Every part of this job that a machine could take was paperwork, and there is a lot of it.

entries.title: Photographer
entries.why: First published. Generated images killed the stock market. They cannot attend your wedding.

entries.title: Recruiter
entries.why: First published. Both sides now use AI, so volume is worthless. Persuading one specific person is not.

entries.title: Software Developer
entries.why: First published. Writing the code stopped being the hard part. Knowing what to build never was.

entries.title: Teacher
entries.why: First published. AI is a spectacular tutor and a hopeless teacher. The difference is the room.

entries.title: Translator
entries.why: First published. The volume work is already priced at zero. What is left is the work where being wrong is expensive.

entries.title: Truck Driver
entries.why: First published. The highway middle is going. The first mile, the last mile and the paperwork are not.

entries.title: Video Editor
entries.why: First published. The tedious half of editing is gone. Rhythm, and knowing when to cut, is not.
